---
title: "Prompt Patterns"
---

## Explain Code

```text
Explain this R code line by line for someone learning actuarial data analysis.
Point out any assumptions it makes about the data.
```

## Debug Error

```text
I received this R error. Explain the likely cause and suggest two things I should check before changing the code.
```

## Review Assumptions

```text
Review this actuarial summary code. What assumptions does it make about exposure, claims, missing values, and grouping variables?
```

## Improve Reproducibility

```text
Review this Quarto analysis for reproducibility. Suggest improvements related to file paths, package loading, seeds, intermediate objects, and output checks.
```
